ex.en: I need to charge my cellphone.
ex.zh: 我需要幫手機充電。

ex.en: Is there a place where I can charge my cellphone around here?
ex.zh: 這附近有可以幫手機充電的地方嗎？

ex.en: First of all, power off your cellphones and remain silent.
ex.zh: 首先，請將手機關機並保持安靜。

cellphone.en: a small phone that you can carry and use anywhere

ex.en: Please attach a certificate of quality.
ex.zh: 請附上品質證明書。

ex.en: Where's my birth certificate?
ex.zh: 我的出生證明在哪裡？

ex.en: You'll receive a certificate after finishing the course.
ex.zh: 完成課程後你會拿到一張證書。

certificate.en: an official paper that shows a fact is true or that you have passed a course

ex.en: Tom is a celebrity.
ex.zh: 湯姆是名人。

ex.en: You're a celebrity now.
ex.zh: 你現在是名人了。

ex.en: Mary is obsessed with celebrities.
ex.zh: 瑪麗很迷名人。

ex.en: There is a fly on the ceiling.
ex.zh: 天花板上面有隻蒼蠅。

ex.en: The device is attached fast to the ceiling.
ex.zh: 這個裝置牢牢固定在天花板上。

ex.en: The ceiling in this room is very high.
ex.zh: 這個房間的天花板很高。

ceiling.en: the flat surface that forms the top of a room

ex.en: The government set a ceiling on rent increases.
ex.zh: 政府對房租漲幅設了上限。

ex.en: There is a price ceiling of 500 dollars.
ex.zh: 價格上限是五百元。

ceiling.en: the highest amount or level that is allowed

ex.en: This building is LEED Platinum certified.
ex.zh: 這棟建築獲得 LEED 白金級認證。

ex.en: The factory is certified to ISO 9001 standards.
ex.zh: 這座工廠通過 ISO 9001 認證。

ex.en: This document certifies that you completed the course.
ex.zh: 這份文件證明你已完成課程。

certify.en: to officially say that something is true or meets a standard

ex.en: I am almost 180 centimeters tall.
ex.zh: 我差不多 180 公分高。

ex.en: The average height of the girls in class is over 155 centimeters.
ex.zh: 這班女生的平均身高超過 155 公分。

ex.en: My brother is two years older than I, but he is three centimeters shorter.
ex.zh: 我哥哥比我大兩歲，卻比我矮三公分。

centimeter.en: a unit for measuring length, equal to one hundredth of a metre

ex.en: I can say with certainty that he hates me.
ex.zh: 我可以肯定地說他討厭我。

ex.en: No one can predict the future with certainty.
ex.zh: 沒有人能確切預測未來。

certainty.en: the feeling of being completely sure about something

ex.en: Rain is a certainty in this season.
ex.zh: 這個季節一定會下雨。

ex.en: It's a certainty that prices will rise.
ex.zh: 物價一定會上漲。

ex.en: It has ceased raining.
ex.zh: 雨停了。

ex.en: The company ceased operations last year.
ex.zh: 那家公司去年停止營運。

ex.en: Production will cease at the end of the month.
ex.zh: 生產將在月底停止。

cease.en: to stop happening or stop doing something

cease.zh: never cease to：總是讓人（驚訝等）

ex.en: His behavior never ceases to surprise me.
ex.zh: 他的所作所為總是讓我驚訝。

ex.en: His memory never ceases to astonish me.
ex.zh: 他的記憶力總是讓我驚嘆。

cease.en: to always do something, again and again

ex.en: A ceasefire was declared.
ex.zh: 雙方宣布停火。

ex.en: Both sides agreed to a ceasefire.
ex.zh: 雙方同意停火。

ceasefire.en: an agreement to stop fighting for a period of time

ex.en: The company decided to centralize its purchasing.
ex.zh: 公司決定把採購集中管理。

ex.en: All customer data is centralized in one system.
ex.zh: 所有客戶資料都集中在同一個系統裡。

centralize.en: to bring control of something under one place or group

ex.en: According to the latest census, the language's number of speakers appears to be stable, or even increasing.
ex.zh: 根據最新的人口普查，這個語言的使用人數似乎持平，甚至還在增加。

ex.en: The government conducts a census every ten years.
ex.zh: 政府每十年進行一次人口普查。

census.en: an official count of the people living in a country, with details about them

ex.en: Our school is in the center of the town.
ex.zh: 我們學校在市中心。

ex.en: The library is in the center of the city.
ex.zh: 圖書館位於市中心。

ex.en: At the city center, there are many tall buildings.
ex.zh: 市中心有很多高樓。

center.en: the middle part of a place or thing

center.zh: （某種活動的）中心、重鎮；中心（機構）

ex.en: Tokyo, as you know, is one of the financial centers of the world.
ex.zh: 如你所知，東京是全球的金融中心之一。

ex.en: The town developed into the center of the economy.
ex.zh: 這座城鎮發展成了經濟中心。

ex.en: The shopping center opens at ten.
ex.zh: 購物中心十點開門。

center.en: a place where a lot of an activity happens, or a building used for a special purpose

ex.en: The novel is centered on the Civil War.
ex.zh: 這部小說以南北戰爭為主軸。

ex.en: The discussion centered on the new budget.
ex.zh: 討論的重點集中在新預算上。

center.en: to have something as the main subject or focus

ex.en: I am certain that we will find a solution.
ex.zh: 我確信我們會找到解決辦法。

ex.en: I don't know for certain when he will come.
ex.zh: 我不確定他什麼時候會來。

ex.en: It's still not certain who's going to win this match.
ex.zh: 這場比賽誰會贏還不確定。

ex.en: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.
ex.zh: 這間老農舍有一種特別的魅力。

ex.en: I have a certain amount of money on me.
ex.zh: 我身上帶了一些錢。

ex.en: Certain items cannot be returned after purchase.
ex.zh: 某些商品購買後無法退貨。

certain.en: used to talk about something particular without saying exactly what it is

ex.en: You've worked hard for months and have certainly earned a holiday.
ex.zh: 你辛苦工作了好幾個月，當然該放個假。

ex.en: The weatherman's forecast is almost certainly wrong.
ex.zh: 氣象預報幾乎肯定是錯的。

ex.en: I certainly wouldn't want to be seen with Tom.
ex.zh: 我當然不想被人看到跟湯姆在一起。

ex.en: Certainly. I'll look for it right now.
ex.zh: 當然，我馬上去找。

ex.en: "Can you help me?" "Certainly."
ex.zh: 「你可以幫我嗎？」「當然可以。」

certainly.en: used to answer yes to a request or question in a polite way

ex.en: As people get older, their brain cells become less efficient.
ex.zh: 隨著年紀增長，腦細胞的效率會變差。

ex.en: The cells have the capacity to convert food into energy.
ex.zh: 細胞有將食物轉化為能量的能力。

ex.en: Human tissue is made up of cells.
ex.zh: 人體組織是由細胞構成的。

cell.en: the smallest basic part of a living thing

ex.en: I'm going to buy a cell phone tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天要去買手機。

ex.en: When I don't have my cell phone, I feel lonely.
ex.zh: 沒有手機的時候我會覺得很寂寞。

ex.en: "Have you seen my cell phone?" "It's on the table."
ex.zh: 「你有看到我的手機嗎？」「在桌上。」

cell.en: a small phone that you can carry and use anywhere

ex.en: Click on the cell and type the number.
ex.zh: 點選儲存格，然後輸入數字。

ex.en: Cell B2 shows the total.
ex.zh: B2 儲存格顯示總數。

cell.en: a box in a spreadsheet where you can write a number or word

ex.en: It costs 25 dollars and 50 cents.
ex.zh: 價錢是二十五元五十分。

ex.en: You gave me only fifty cents.
ex.zh: 你只給了我五十分錢。

cent.en: a small coin worth one hundredth of a dollar

ex.en: These cardboard boxes are a hundred per cent recyclable.
ex.zh: 這些紙箱百分之百可回收。

ex.en: Prices rose by five per cent last year.
ex.zh: 去年物價上漲了百分之五。

ex.en: Is there central heating in this building?
ex.zh: 這棟大樓有中央暖氣系統嗎？

ex.en: Our office is in central Taipei.
ex.zh: 我們的辦公室在台北市中心。

central.en: in or near the middle of a place

ex.en: What is the central aim of this plan?
ex.zh: 這個計畫的主要目的是什麼？

ex.en: Customer service is central to our business.
ex.zh: 客戶服務是我們事業的核心。

central.en: most important, with other things depending on it

ex.en: Let's have a good birthday celebration!
ex.zh: 我們來好好慶祝生日吧！

ex.en: I feel a little guilty that I didn't invite him to join the celebration.
ex.zh: 我沒邀請他參加慶祝活動，覺得有點內疚。

ex.en: The company held a celebration for its 20th anniversary.
ex.zh: 公司舉辦了二十週年慶祝活動。

celebration.en: an event or party to show that a day or success is special

ex.en: The movie was censored before it was shown on TV.
ex.zh: 這部電影在電視播出前被刪剪過。

ex.en: Some words in the song were censored.
ex.zh: 這首歌裡有些字被消音了。

censor.en: to remove parts of a film or book that are thought to be unsuitable

ex.en: The censors cut several scenes from the film.
ex.zh: 審查人員從電影中剪掉了幾個片段。

ex.en: The book had to be approved by a censor.
ex.zh: 這本書必須經過審查員核准。

censor.en: a person whose job is to check films or books and remove unsuitable parts

certified.zh: 經認證的、有執照的、合格的

ex.en: He's a certified cardiologist.
ex.zh: 他是有執照的心臟科醫師。

ex.en: Ziri became a certified online teacher.
ex.zh: 齊莉成為合格的線上教師。

ex.en: This building is LEED Platinum certified.
ex.zh: 這棟建築已獲得 LEED 白金級認證。

certified.en: officially approved as having the right training or standard

ex.en: Please send the contract by certified mail.
ex.zh: 請用掛號寄送合約。

ex.en: I received a certified letter from the bank.
ex.zh: 我收到銀行寄來的掛號信。

certified.en: sent in a way that gives proof that a letter was delivered

ex.en: J.F. Kennedy was buried in Arlington Cemetery.
ex.zh: 約翰甘迺迪被安葬在阿靈頓公墓。

ex.en: The old cemetery is on a hill outside the village.
ex.zh: 那座老公墓位在村子外的山丘上。

cemetery.en: a place where dead people are buried

ex.en: The film was banned because of government censorship.
ex.zh: 這部電影因為政府審查而被禁。

ex.en: Internet censorship is strict in some countries.
ex.zh: 有些國家的網路審查很嚴格。

censorship.en: the system of removing parts of books or films that are thought to be unsuitable

ex.en: Kate hardly ever celebrates her birthday.
ex.zh: 凱特幾乎從不慶祝生日。

ex.en: On February 14 Americans celebrate St. Valentine's Day.
ex.zh: 美國人在 2 月 14 日慶祝情人節。

ex.en: Celebrating Spring Festival is commonly referred to as 'passing the year'.
ex.zh: 慶祝春節一般叫做「過年」。

celebrate.en: to do something enjoyable on a special day or after a success

ex.en: The opening ceremony of the Olympics has already begun.
ex.zh: 奧運開幕典禮已經開始了。

ex.en: The Oscar ceremonies are Hollywood's biggest extravaganza.
ex.zh: 奧斯卡頒獎典禮是好萊塢最盛大的活動。

ex.en: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.
ex.zh: 我不想參加典禮。

ceremony.en: a formal public event held on a special occasion

ex.en: Much of London was destroyed in the seventeenth century.
ex.zh: 倫敦有很大一部分在十七世紀被毀。

ex.en: 2001 is the year when the 21st century begins.
ex.zh: 2001 年是 21 世紀的開始。

ex.en: The construction straddled two centuries.
ex.zh: 這項工程橫跨了兩個世紀。

century.en: a period of one hundred years

ex.zh: 您可以跳過認證流程的第三階段，直接進入第六階段。

ex.en: The factory received ISO certification last year.
ex.zh: 這家工廠去年取得了 ISO 認證。

certification.en: the process of getting official proof that you have the right skills or standard

ex.zh: 出口商提交了原產地證明書。

ex.zh: 原產地證明書可能有助於降低進口關稅。

certificate of origin.en: an official paper that shows which country goods were made in

ex.en: The cement will set in a couple of hours.
ex.zh: 水泥再過幾個小時就會凝固。

ex.zh: 承包商為地基追加訂購了水泥。

cement.en: a grey powder that is mixed with water and sand to make a hard building material

ex.en: The library is in the centre of the city.
ex.zh: 圖書館位於市中心。

ex.en: There is a large table in the centre of the room.
ex.zh: 房間中央有一張大桌子。

ex.zh: 我們去了我家附近的運動中心。

ex.en: The discussion centred on the cost of the project.
ex.zh: 討論的重點集中在專案的成本上。

ex.zh: 她的生活以家人為重心。

ex.en: The CEO announced the new plan at the staff meeting.
ex.zh: 執行長在員工會議上宣布了新計畫。

ex.en: She became the CEO of the company at the age of forty.
ex.zh: 她四十歲時成為這間公司的執行長。

ex.zh: 科學家在顯微鏡下研究植物的細胞結構。

ex.en: The disease damages cellular functions in the body.
ex.zh: 這種疾病會破壞身體的細胞功能。

cellular.zh: 行動電話的、蜂巢式通訊的

ex.en: The area has poor cellular coverage, so my phone often loses signal.
ex.zh: 這個地區的行動通訊訊號很差，我的手機常常收不到訊號。

ex.en: He still uses an old cellular phone with big buttons.
ex.zh: 他仍然使用一支有大按鍵的舊手機。

ex.zh: 我早餐通常吃一碗加牛奶的麥片。

ex.zh: 小孩通常比較喜歡甜的穀片，而不是吐司。

ex.zh: 我們的麥片吃完了，所以我今天會再買一些。

ex.zh: 小麥、稻米和玉米是重要的穀類作物。

ex.en: The farmer grows cereal on most of his land.
ex.zh: 那位農夫在大部分土地上種植穀物。

ex.zh: 穀類是人類能量的主要來源。

ex.zh: 我們把陳年的酒放在涼爽的地窖裡。

ex.zh: 這棟房子有個潮濕、帶著泥土味的地下室。

ex.zh: 她走下地窖去找一些馬鈴薯。

ex.zh: Celia 是源自拉丁文的女孩名字。

ex.zh: 西莉亞畫了牆上那幅畫。

ex.zh: 我們在一家小餐廳為她慶生。

ex.en: They celebrated the end of exams with a big dinner.
ex.zh: 他們用一頓大餐慶祝考試結束。

ex.en: She is a celebrated author known around the world.
ex.zh: 她是享譽全球的著名作家。

ex.en: The celebrated chef opened a new restaurant downtown.
ex.zh: 這位知名主廚在市中心開了一家新餐廳。

ex.en: The hotel is centrally located near the station.
ex.zh: 這間旅館位於市中心，靠近車站。

ex.en: The office is centrally heated in winter.
ex.zh: 這間辦公室冬天有中央暖氣系統。

ex.zh: 她在當地市集買了一個陶瓷碗。

ex.en: The ceramic tiles in the kitchen are easy to clean.
ex.zh: 廚房的瓷磚很好清理。

ex.en: The museum has a fine collection of ancient ceramics.
ex.zh: 這間博物館收藏了許多精美的古代陶瓷。

ex.en: He makes ceramics in a small studio behind his house.
ex.zh: 他在屋後的小工作室裡製作陶瓷。

ex.en: She took a class in ceramics and made her own bowl.
ex.zh: 她上了陶藝課，做出自己的碗。

ex.en: The museum has a fine collection of ancient Chinese ceramics.
ex.zh: 這間博物館收藏了精美的中國古代陶瓷。

ex.zh: 把芹菜切碎加進湯裡。

ex.zh: 他把一根芹菜條沾了沾醬料。

ex.en: A bowl of fresh fruit served as the centerpiece on the table.
ex.zh: 一碗新鮮水果成了桌子中央的擺飾。

ex.en: The new fountain is the centerpiece of the park.
ex.zh: 新的噴泉是這座公園的焦點。

ex.en: Stars and planets are celestial bodies.
ex.zh: 恆星和行星都是天體。

ex.en: The astronomer studied celestial maps of the night sky.
ex.zh: 天文學家研究夜空的星圖。

ex.en: The choir sang with celestial beauty.
ex.zh: 合唱團以天籟般的美感歌唱。

ex.en: The paintings showed angels in a celestial garden.
ex.zh: 這些畫作描繪了天使在天國花園中的情景。

ex.zh: 這個箱子是用芳香的雪松做的。

ex.en: Tall cedars grew along the mountain path.
ex.zh: 高大的雪松沿著山路生長。

ex.zh: 跌倒後，醫師檢查了是否有腦部損傷。

ex.en: The cerebral cortex controls thinking and memory.
ex.zh: 大腦皮質掌管思考與記憶。

ex.en: He prefers cerebral movies that make you think.
ex.zh: 他偏愛那些會讓人思考的理性電影。

ex.en: Chess is a cerebral game.
ex.zh: 西洋棋是個需要動腦的遊戲。

ex.zh: 這張桌子大約八十公分寬。

ex.en: Cut the paper into strips one centimetre thick.
ex.zh: 把紙剪成一公分寬的長條。

ex.zh: 市長在開幕儀式上剪綵。

ex.en: The soldiers wore ceremonial uniforms for the parade.
ex.zh: 士兵們穿著典禮用的制服參加遊行。

ex.zh: 皇室婚禮的盛大儀式吸引了數千名遊客。

ex.en: Each country has its own ceremonial for welcoming guests.
ex.zh: 每個國家都有自己迎接貴賓的禮儀。

ex.zh: 學校以盛大的遊行慶祝建校一百週年。

ex.en: The town held a festival to mark the centenary of the library.
ex.zh: 鎮上舉辦慶典，紀念圖書館成立一百週年。

ex.zh: 百週年慶祝活動持續了一整個星期。

ex.zh: 他們印製了這本書的百週年紀念版。

ex.zh: 這家公司用集中式系統儲存客戶資料。

ex.en: France has a more centralized government than many countries.
ex.zh: 法國的政府比許多國家更中央集權。
